name: agent-rules
description: Agent Rules harness — cross-platform context management for AI coding assistants

scripts.check:whitespace: node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process');let b;try{b=execSync('git merge-base HEAD origin/main',{encoding:'utf-8'}).trim()}catch(e){console.error('Cannot determine merge base');process.exit(1)}try{execSync('git diff --check '+b+'..HEAD',{encoding:'utf-8',stdio:['ignore','pipe','pipe']});console.log('Whitespace OK')}catch(e){const o=(e.stdout||'')+(e.stderr||'');const lines=o.split('\n').filter(l=>!l.includes('profiles/5fedu/reference-projects/')&&!l.includes('generated/runtime-build/'));if(lines.some(l=>l.trim())){console.error(lines.join('\n'));process.exit(1)}else{console.log('Whitespace OK')}}"
scripts.verify:all: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:python && npm run validate && npm run verify-mirrors && npm run check:whitespace
